description.value:
Your throat is implanted with a necrotic modulator that can unleash a powerful screech. The tissue is typically taken from a banshee, though some come from tech zombies and other more common undead.

Activate—Shriek 2 (sonic)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Each creature in a 15-foot cone takes @Damage[1d10[sonic]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save. Creatures that fail this save become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Deafened] until the start of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure).
